_doc: Clusters group PRs by hardware target + shared model so weights download ONCE and same-model tasks run back-to-back. run.sh workloads iterates clusters in `order`. download.sh fetches into .weights/<key> (gitignored); nothing downloads until run on the target box. GPU clusters skip when no --gpus present (rows stay reported-only/pending).

none_cpu.notes: Pure-CPU microbench / repo_benchmark / pytest. No weights. Runs + measures here on arm Mac.

none_gpu.notes: GPU kernel / Triton microbench, no model weights but needs CUDA. Scaffold only here; execute on GPU box. 12583 also loads Mixtral config via --model (see mixtral cluster).

opt125m.notes: Serving / throughput bench on opt-125m. Smallest real model.

qwen05b.notes: 6779 e2e_qwen05b arm (it/s) + 28280 serving. 6779's CPU microbench arm is in none_cpu; only the e2e arm needs this.

llama8b_fp8.notes: Prefix-caching serving (9972) + 28280 sharegpt serving. Large; only on GPU box with disk.

mixtral.notes: DEFERRED to LAST. ~90GB, multi-GPU TP=2. download.sh refuses unless ALLOW_MIXTRAL=1. Run only on a box that can hold it.
